native.spi_controller_profile: Actual controller implementation, no universal byte count or50MHz capability.
native.spi_bus_variant: Actual single-data SPI versus separately qualified dual/quad memory phases.
native.spi_role: Actual clock-owning controller versus selected target.
native.spi_duplex: Actual simultaneous TX/RX versus shared half-duplex data line.
native.spi_bit_order: Actual matched data bit order, PIC32MX shifts most significant bit first.
native.spi_sample_edge: Actual data sampling rising/falling edge matched across endpoints.
native.spi_change_edge: Actual data change edge distinct from sampling edge.
native.spi_cs_polarity: Actual chip-select active polarity, no universal reset/active-low evidence.
native.spi_select_kind: Actual selection per transaction, daisy-chain or externally bound framed sync.
native.spi_outcome: Actual independent decoding and consuming application result.
native.spi_cpol: Actual idle clock level0/1, separate phase.
native.spi_word_bits: Actual controller and target word length, PIC32MX8/16/32 but other parts differ.
native.spi_words: Actual transfer word count; dummy/address/command phases included separately.
native.spi_transfer_clock_bits: Actual whole transaction clock pulses across all phases, not TXbytes+RXbytes for simultaneous full duplex.
native.spi_command_bits: Actual command phase bits, independent device framing.
native.spi_address_bits: Actual address phase bits, not an I2C slave address.
native.spi_data_bits: Actual data-phase clock bits including selected word packing.
native.spi_tx_bits: Actual simultaneously clocked transmit data bits, not sum withreceive for full duplex.
native.spi_rx_bits: Actual receive data bits clocked by same SCK in full duplex.
native.spi_controller_max_bps: Actual qualified SCK controller maximum under clock/pad/voltage/temp conditions.
native.spi_target_max_bps: Actual selected target SCK maximum under actual mode/voltage/temp/load.
native.spi_high_ns: Actual stable clock HIGH duration, device-qualified minimum.
native.spi_low_ns: Actual stable clock LOW duration, device-qualified minimum.
native.spi_rise_ns: Actual SCK transition rise time included in full period.
native.spi_fall_ns: Actual SCK transition fall time included in full period.
native.spi_data_setup_ns: Actual received data stable before sampling edge.
native.spi_minimum_setup_ns: Actual receiver setup requirement including skew/load/temp.
native.spi_data_hold_ns: Actual data stable after sampling edge.
native.spi_cs_setup_ns: Actual chip-select setup before first relevant clock.
native.spi_cs_hold_ns: Actual chip-select hold after last relevant clock.
native.spi_output_valid_ns: Actual remote output valid worst-case after launch edge.
native.spi_path_delay_ns: Actual combined clock/data propagation delay for selected sampling direction.
native.spi_sample_window_ns: Actual launch-to-sample window for selected phase/controller, not alwayshalfperiod.
native.spi_setup_bound_us: Actual whole transaction preclock setup upper bound.
native.spi_gap_bound_us: Actual total intra-transaction/gap/ready wait bound, not just nominalonegap.
native.spi_transaction_bound_us: Actual clock plus setup/hold/allgaps upper envelope, separate application scheduling.
native.spi_ready_wait_us: Actual asynchronous device-ready wait bound; source600ns example is not bound.
native.spi_peripheral_clock_bps: Actual selected PIC32PBCLK, not CPU clock by default.
native.spi_brg: Actual9bit PIC32 baud divider register0..511, not raw divider.
native.spi_pic32_ckp: Actual PIC32CKP clock idle setting matches CPOL.
native.spi_pic32_cke: Actual PIC32 output-edge select; normalmode CKE=1-CPHA, framedmust0.
native.spi_pic32_smp: Actual PIC32 input sample middle/end setting, targetalways0.
native.spi_selected_targets: Actual enabled outputs in ordinary single-CS transaction, no CANarbitration.
native.spi_ready_enabled: Actual device READY/handshake enabled and allocated.
native.spi_framed: Actual controller framed sync mode versus ordinarychipselect.
native.spi_idle: Actual module idle when changing word width.
native.spi_peer_mode_verified: Actual matching mode/word/order/duplex across controller and target.
native.spi_tri_state_verified: Actual unselected target output isolation prevents shared MISO contention.
native.spi_chip_select: Actual canonical target selection or explicit framed binding.
native.spi_device_source: Actual controller/target datasheet revisions and firmware configuration.
native.local_timing_evidence.master_node_id: Actual confirmed canonical clock owner, not assigned ECU.
native.local_timing_evidence.word_length_bits: Actual positive integer word length qualified bydevice.
native.local_timing_evidence.duplex_mode: Actual full/halfduplex singleSPI transfer, no dualquad inference.
native.local_timing_evidence.transfer_bits_boun: Actual whole transaction clock pulse upperbound includingcommand/address/dummy/packing.
native.local_timing_evidence.source: Actual device/transaction trace or datasheet source.
native.local_timing_evidence.confirmed: Explicit confirmation of whole-device transaction proof, never a nominalclock default.
native.bitrate: Actual device-qualified selected SCK, no universal minimum/50MHz source default. Separate rate_model positive input requirement and actual controller/target/PCB limit.
native.payload_bytes: Actual data bytes separate whole command/address/dummy/packing and simultaneous TX/RX. No65535byte universal SPI limit.
